scene.ko: 온라인으로 산 표의 좌석이 화면에 너무 가까워서 매표소에서 뒤쪽 자리로 바꾸고, 예고편 시간을 묻는다.

lines.en: Hi. I bought two tickets online, but I'd like to change our seats.
lines.ko: 안녕하세요. 온라인으로 표 두 장을 샀는데요, 자리를 바꾸고 싶어요.
alt: Hi. I booked two tickets online. Can I change our seats?
Hello. I'd like to change the seats on my online tickets.

lines.en: Sure. Can I see your booking number?
lines.ko: 네. 예매 번호 좀 보여 주시겠어요?

lines.en: Here it is. We're in the second row, and that's too close to the screen.
lines.ko: 여기 있어요. 둘째 줄인데 화면에 너무 가까워서요.
alt: Here you go. We're in row two, and it's too close to the screen.

lines.en: I see. There are two seats together in row J. Would that work?
lines.ko: 그렇군요. J열에 나란히 붙은 자리가 두 개 있어요. 괜찮으시겠어요?

lines.en: That sounds perfect. Is there an extra charge?
alt: Perfect. Do I need to pay extra?
That's great. Does it cost more?

lines.en: No, it's the same price. Here are your new tickets.
lines.ko: 아니요, 가격은 같아요. 새 표 여기 있습니다.

lines.en: Thanks. By the way, how long are the previews before the movie?
lines.ko: 고마워요. 그런데 영화 전에 예고편은 얼마나 해요?
alt: Thank you. How long are the trailers before it starts?
Thanks. How many minutes of previews are there?

lines.en: About fifteen minutes, so you have time to grab some snacks.

expressions.en: I'd like to change our seats.

expressions.note: Do I need to pay extra? 와 같은 뜻
